urls.rationale: RCW Chapter 42.17A (Disclosure — Campaign Finance, Lobbying, Records) is the unified statute body containing lobbyist registration (.600), lobbyist reporting (.615), grass-roots lobbying (.640), employer-of-lobbyist reports (.630), and lobbyist duties/penalties (.655); the Justia anchor abbreviates the title but the chapter is WA's sole lobbying-disclosure regime.

notes: Chapter 42.52 (Ethics in public service) is an executive-branch ethics code that overlaps with gift rules but is not lobbying disclosure proper — excluded per pass-2 Rule 4 (out-of-scope: ethics rules not tied to lobbying disclosure). 42.17A is per-section-leaf at this vintage, so pass-3 enumeration follows.
